This [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] '''Star Destroyer''' was an early [[Superlaser Star Destroyer]], fitted with a prototype [[Superlaser/Legends|superlaser]]. 

==Description==
The ship was equipped with power generation facilities capable of feeding a weapon that could pulverize a large asteroid.<ref name="LOTJR" /> It was propelled by four thrusters.
The ship had a split down the middle similar to the ancient [[Harrower-class dreadnought|''Harrower''-class dreadnought]] and the later superlaser-equipped [[Conqueror (superlaser)|''Conqueror'']]. In addition, it also possessed flaps similar to that of a ''Victory''-class Star Destroyer.<ref name="ERC" />

==History==
It was used against a gathering of early resistance leaders on a remote [[Jedi asteroid|asteroid]], wiping most of them out before they could become a serious threat to the Empire.<ref name="LOTJR" />
